wedgeSits.commitLine: "Done. The north treeline by the fallen oak, at sunup. Pack and knife. We travel light."

wedgeSits.name: A person, maybe 30s, with grey-streaked hair
Theo
wedgeSits.commitLine: "I'm out on the road, away from Haven — no dawn meet while I'm out, I'm afraid. Catch me when I'm back and we'll set it then."

wedgeSits.name: Theo
wedgeSits.commitLine: "Out on the road, away from Haven. A dawn meet's not something I can promise while I'm out — when I'm back, find me, and we'll set it then."

wedgeSits.name: Theo
wedgeSits.commitLine: "Wait — I'm away from Haven, out on the road. I can't promise a dawn meet while I'm out — find me when I'm back, and we'll set it then."

wedgeSits.name: Theo
wedgeSits.commitLine: "Wait — I'm away from Haven right now, out on the road. I can't promise a dawn meet from out here — find me when I'm back and we'll set it then."
